topics.title: Deep-sea miner plans $1 billion merger
topics.summary: American Ocean Minerals, led by former Rio Tinto chief Tom Albanese, will merge with Odyssey Marine Exploration in a $1 billion all-stock deal. The company said the combined group will target underwater mineral deposits and list on Nasdaq under the ticker AOMC.
topics.detail: The deal was announced on October 11. The company said the merger will bring together a portfolio of deep-sea mineral assets, including polymetallic nodules. The article said the close is expected by August. It also said the industry still faces diplomatic and regulatory challenges.

sources.title: Ex-Rio Tinto CEO's deep-sea mining firm to merge with Odyssey in $1 billion deal

topics.title: Verstappen wins Singapore Grand Prix
topics.summary: Max Verstappen won the Singapore Grand Prix on October 11. One report said Lewis Hamilton finished second and Charles Leclerc third, while another said the weekend was the scheduled Singapore round before the championship paused until Austin.
topics.detail: The race took place at Marina Bay as part of the 2026 Formula 1 schedule. Coverage also noted that there were no championship sessions on October 17 or 18, with the next race set for October 23 to 25 in Austin. Multiple results pages and reports on the event were published during the window.
